svg.title: Complex tensors, zero-copy views and conjugate-Wirtinger gradients
svg.desc: A 2-by-2 complex64 tensor x passes through a zero-copy transpose view and a materializing reshape into a length-4 vector y; the energy term conjugate of y times y produces a per-element squared magnitude. A dashed violet path returns the conjugate-Wirtinger gradient 2x.
svg.text: Views, squared magnitude, and a complex-aware gradient
d energy / d x = 2 · x — a complex output requires an explicit cotangent
